messages:
Ana (Partnerships): FYI0: partner ops sync tomorrow 9am PT to finalize Q2 MDF allocations and scorecard owners. Need rough asks in the sheet by EOD Thu.
Mike (Growth): A quick note : for marketplace we need both installs and ARR-sourced attribution. Will pull and paste CSV.
Sarah_pd: Re product metrics: please include feature flags used, customer config that enabled integration, and measured time-to-value where available.
Devon (Sales): For HW partners, can we require a reference PoC or showroom demo for Tier A funding? Last time funds went to partners that never shipped on time.
Lina_finance: We can add a clause in the MDF T&C. Also reminder we have a hard cap: total MDF pool is $160k this quarter unless leadership approves reallocation.
Ana (Partnerships): Noted Lina. Proposal from the partnership team: split 45% HW, 30% SI/co-sell, 25% marketplace/co-marketing. Thoughts?
Mike (Growth): That seems fair; marketplace demand has grown but hardware commitments tend to drive large ARR. If we do 45% HW that means ~72k.
Devon (Sales): Suggest tier thresholds: Tier A (>30k ask) requires certified joint-eng deliverable + 2 pilot commitments. Tier B (5-30k) requires enablement plan + 1 committed opportunity.
Sarah_pd: Can we add a quality gate on product impact? e.g., predicted NRR influence or pilot-to-closed conversion estimate. I can provide a simple rubric.
Jordan_ops: I'll sign off operationally but we need lines for reserved contingency (we typically keep 3-5%). Recommend 5% contingency = 8k.
Lina_finance: 5% contingency is fine if tracked separately. Also need justification for any requests over 25k in the packet.
Ana (Partnerships): OK action items: Devon -> populate HW partner asks (owners + rationale) by Thu 12pm; Mike -> marketplace installs+ARR CSV by Thu EOD; Sarah -> rubric draft for product impact by Thu EOD; Jordan -> confirm final pool and contingency by Fri morning; Lina -> provide MDF T&C template for signoff by Fri.
partner-bot: Reminder: QBR folder updated and permission granted to partnerships+, growth+, finance+. Deadline: submit scorecards by Fri 23:59 UTC.
Devon (Sales): One operational question: do we need signed MOU before funds are disbursed?
Lina_finance: We require a signed MSA or co-marketing agreement for any MDF >15k. For <15k a standard MDF form + invoice is acceptable.
Mike (Growth): Re co-marketing spend: can we create a small creative budget line (2-5k) per partner for campaigns? Improves conversion.
Ana (Partnerships): We already have a suggested line item for creative. Let's cap at 5k per partner unless exec OKs overage.
Sarah_pd: If everyone agrees I'll validate the rubric and then we can add a "product impact" column in the scorecard.
Devon (Sales): I'll start populating with AcmeHW, CoreBoards, and TitanEdge. Expect initial asks: 30k, 15k, 20k respectively.
Jordan_ops: Noted. I'll confirm the final pool after payroll run (should be stable).
Ana (Partnerships): Great. I'll send calendar invites and include the QBR slide template. If anyone needs to adjust owners speak now. Thanks!
partner-bot: Event created: "Q2 Partner Ops MDF Review" on May 14 09:00 PT.
Ana (Partnerships): Closing thread : ping me in DMs if anything changes.
